app.name: SaqBol
app.tagline: Check a message before you lose money
home.lead: Paste a message, SMS or chat you are unsure about. SaqBol marks the exact words that make it look like a scam, names the script it follows, and tells you what to do next.
form.label: Message to check
form.error.empty: Paste a message or add a screenshot first.
form.error.too_long: That message is longer than {max} characters. Paste the important part.
form.error.failed: The check could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
form.error.rate_limited: Daily limit reached. Try again later.
form.samples.title: Or try one of these
form.samples.hint: Real scam scripts, plus one genuine bank notification.
form.image.label: Or a screenshot
form.image.hint: Drop a screenshot here or choose a file. PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
form.image.too_large: That file is over 5 MB. Try a smaller screenshot, or paste the text.
form.image.wrong_type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP will work.
form.image.unsupported: Screenshot checks are coming soon. For now, copy the text of the message and paste it in the box above.
card.text.title: The message, with the evidence marked
card.evidence.unanchored: {n} piece(s) of evidence could not be located in the text and are not marked above.
share.title: Warn someone
share.warning.likely_safe: No signs of a scam were found, but stay alert.
share.page.lead: SaqBol recognises this script from the text of a message. Check yours — it is free and takes a second.
mock.banner: Demo data. The analysis backend is not connected in this build.
